/v2/positions.description: List independently identified economic Positions across the selected Accounts. Each Position has its own GUID and links to its currently applicable Construction. The default summary and optional expansions preserve financial qualifications. State and observed exposure are separate: UNRESOLVED can coexist with known held quantities. Source observations do not prove an opening date or uninterrupted occurrence. Selection, stable ID ordering and pagination precede per-item evaluation; Account-wide allocation and coverage checks still apply.

/v2/positions/{positionId}.description: Read one independently identified economic Position, its current Construction link and evidence-qualified financial evaluation. Broker series identifiers are source attributes, so distinct occurrences may share them. CLOSED is terminal and a later established opening requires a different GUID; this rule does not prove a lifecycle transition from incomplete holdings history. Original, current and cumulative economics remain separate when available. Unavailable basis, market history or associations produce qualified values and warnings.

/v2/holdings.description: List broker custody observations independently of Position interpretation or Construction recognition. With snapshotId omitted, select the latest admitted snapshot independently for each selected Account; retained historical snapshots are not added to current custody. A partial latest snapshot retains its coverage qualification. A failed acquisition does not erase prior admitted evidence. An empty latest cut is empty, not a reason to substitute an older cut. Use accountId with snapshotId for an exact historical cut, or view=observations to discover retained cuts and follow their holdings links. Pagination follows stable canonical-ID ordering, not source chronology.

/v2/holdings/{holdingId}.description: Read one immutable Account-scoped broker holding observation, including its snapshot identity, quantities, source dates and receipt clock, reported monetary values and provenance. Broker-reported P/L and capital requirements retain their source meaning and do not establish Wheelwright opening economics, available buying power or broker-reserved collateral.
